主要内容: Estée Lauder Companies Inc. disclosed restructuring and other charges of approximately $93 million (before tax) in connection with its initiatives under the 'Leading Beauty Forward' strategy, which aims to optimize corporate functions and market support structures. The Company has approved cumulative restructuring charges through March 20, 2018, totaling $669 million, including $360 million in employee-related costs. These charges are categorized into employee-related, asset-related, contract terminations, and other exit costs, with the majority allocated to employee-related expenses. The Company emphasized that these charges are subject to risks and uncertainties, including global market conditions, competition, and its ability to implement its long-term strategic plan. The Company is filing this Form 8-K/A to provide details about specific initiatives approved since December 31, 2017, as part of its restructuring efforts under Leading Beauty Forward, which initially projected restructuring and other charges of $600 million to $700 million (before tax) through fiscal 2021.
